question: What material is a window mostly made of so we can see outside? 🪟
explanation: Super! Glass is clear and see-through, which makes it perfect for making windows! 🪟
hint: It is clear and can break easily.

question: What is a spoon usually made of? 🥄
explanation: Awesome! Spoons are made of strong metal so we can eat our food easily! 🥄
hint: It is hard and shiny.

question: Which of these objects is very soft to touch? 🧸
explanation: Great job! A teddy bear is filled with soft cotton to make it cuddly! 🧸
hint: You love to hug this toy at night.

question: What do we use to make a kite fly high in the sky? 🪁
explanation: Fantastic! Light paper helps the beautiful kite fly easily in the wind! 🪁
hint: It is very light and tears easily.

question: Which of these things will float on top of water? ⛵
explanation: Super! A dry leaf is very light, so it floats beautifully on water! 🍃
hint: It falls from a tree and is very light.

question: What is a writing pencil mostly made of? ✏️
explanation: Wonderful! The outside of a pencil is made of wood to keep it strong! ✏️
hint: This material comes from tall trees.

question: Which object feels rough when you touch it? 🌳
explanation: Great job! The bark of a tree has bumps and lines that make it feel rough! 🪵
hint: It covers the outside of a tree trunk.

question: What is your school uniform made of? 👕
explanation: Awesome! We wear comfortable clothes made of soft cloth everyday! 👗
hint: It is woven from threads.

question: Which material is used to make a car tire? 🚗
explanation: Super! Tires are made of strong rubber so the car can roll smoothly! 🛞
hint: It is black and bouncy.

question: Which of these is a very hard object? 🧱
explanation: Fantastic! Bricks are very hard and strong to help build our houses! 🧱
hint: It is a heavy red block used for building walls.

question: What do we use to make a round water pot? 🏺
explanation: Awesome! Potters use soft clay to shape beautiful round pots! 🏺
hint: It is soft wet mud that becomes hard when dry.

question: Which object feels very smooth to touch? 🍎
explanation: Great job! A mirror is made of smooth glass so we can see our face clearly! 🪞
hint: You look into this to see your smile.

question: What material is best to make a strong key? 🗝️
explanation: Super! Keys must be very strong so they do not break, so we use metal! 🗝️
hint: It is hard, shiny, and makes a clinking sound.

question: Which of these will sink in a bucket of water? 🪣
explanation: Wonderful! A stone is heavy, so it sinks right to the bottom of the water! 🪨
hint: It is hard, heavy, and found on the ground.

question: What do we wear to keep warm in winter? 🧥
explanation: Awesome! Wool is thick and warm, making it perfect for winter sweaters! 🧣
hint: It is fluffy and comes from sheep.

question: What is a bright and shiny object? ✨
explanation: Great job! Metal like gold shines very brightly when light hits it! 💍
hint: It is worn on the finger and sparkles.

question: Which material stretches when you pull it? 🎈
explanation: Super! Rubber is very stretchy and can be pulled far without breaking! 🎗️
hint: We use it to tie hair or papers together.

question: What is a story notebook made of? 📓
explanation: Fantastic! Notebooks have many pages made of paper for us to write on! 📝
hint: We use a pencil to write on this.

question: Which of these blocks the sunlight completely? 🚪
explanation: Awesome! Wood is not see-through, so it blocks the light from coming inside! 🚪
hint: You knock on this to enter a room.

question: What is a colorful school water bottle made of? 🍼
explanation: Great job! Plastic is light and does not break easily, perfect for a water bottle! 💧
hint: It is light and comes in many bright colors.

question: Which of these is very light to carry? 🪶
explanation: Super! A feather from a bird is so light it can float in the air! 🪶
hint: It comes from a bird's wing.

question: What do we use to rub out a pencil mark? 🧼
explanation: Wonderful! An eraser is made of soft rubber that rubs away pencil marks! ✏️
hint: It is in your pencil box.

question: Which material is used to make a bouncy balloon? 🎈
explanation: Awesome! Rubber is stretchy and holds air inside to make a big balloon! 🎈
hint: It stretches and can pop.

question: What is a heavy cricket bat made of? 🏏
explanation: Great job! Wood is strong and perfect for hitting the cricket ball hard! 🏏
hint: It is carved from tree trunks.

question: Which object can you clearly see through? 👓
explanation: Super! Spectacles have clear glass lenses so we can see everything perfectly! 👓
hint: We wear these on our eyes to read better.

question: What do we use to drink hot tea safely? ☕
explanation: Fantastic! A ceramic mug is hard and keeps our hands safe from the hot tea! ☕
hint: It has a handle to hold it.

question: Which of these is a shiny metal? 🪙
explanation: Awesome! Gold is a beautiful, shiny metal used to make lovely jewelry! 💍
hint: It is yellow and very expensive.

question: What do we wear on our feet to protect them outside? 👟
explanation: Great job! Leather shoes are strong and keep our feet safe from sharp stones! 👟
hint: We tie laces on these before running.

question: Which object will break easily if dropped on the floor? 🥛
explanation: Super! Glass is delicate and shatters into pieces if it falls down! 🪟
hint: You drink milk from it but must hold it carefully.

question: What is a raincoat mostly made of? 🧥
explanation: Wonderful! Plastic does not let water pass through, keeping us dry in the rain! ☔
hint: It stops the rain from making you wet.

question: Which of these items is used for cleaning and is very soft? 🧽
explanation: Awesome! A sponge is soft and holds soapy water to wash our dishes clean! 🧽
hint: It is squishy and soaks up water.

question: What is a loud school bell usually made of? 🔔
explanation: Great job! Metal makes a loud ringing sound to tell us it is playtime! 🔔
hint: It makes a ringing 'Ding-Dong' sound.

question: Which of these feels fluffy and soft? ☁️
explanation: Super! Clouds look like soft, fluffy cotton floating high in the sky! ☁️
hint: It is white and floats in the sky.

question: What do we use to neatly comb our hair? 🪮
explanation: Fantastic! A plastic comb has teeth that easily sort out our messy hair! 🪮
hint: It has many small teeth.

question: Which material comes from sheep to make warm clothes? 🐑
explanation: Awesome! We gently shave sheep to get soft wool for knitting sweaters! 🧶
hint: It is spun into yarn to knit.

question: What is the skin of an apple like? 🍎
explanation: Great job! A fresh apple has a beautiful, smooth, and shiny red skin! 🍎
hint: It feels nice and slippery.

question: Which of these is used to make a cooking pan? 🍳
explanation: Super! Metal can get very hot safely, which makes it perfect for cooking food! 🍳
hint: It gets hot quickly on the stove.

question: What material helps us dry our wet hands? 🧴
explanation: Wonderful! Cotton cloth easily soaks up the water and dries our hands! 🧻
hint: It is soft and absorbs water.

question: Which of these things is round and bounces high? 🏀
explanation: Awesome! Rubber is super bouncy, making the ball jump high off the ground! 🏀
hint: You throw it down to make it jump.

question: What is a shiny coin made of? 🪙
explanation: Great job! Coins are made of hard metal so they last a very long time! 🪙
hint: It makes a clink sound when dropped.

question: Which object has a very rough skin? 🥥
explanation: Super! The outside of a coconut has rough brown fibers that feel scratchy! 🥥
hint: It is brown outside and white inside.

question: What do we use to build strong houses? 🏠
explanation: Fantastic! Heavy red bricks are stacked together to make very strong walls! 🏠
hint: They are heavy red blocks.

question: Which of these objects will bend easily? 🎗️
explanation: Awesome! A cloth ribbon is soft and flexes easily so we can tie pretty bows! 🎀
hint: You can tie it in your hair.

question: What is a shiny bathroom mirror made of? 🪞
explanation: Great job! Mirrors have a special shiny layer behind the glass to reflect light! 🪞
hint: You can see your reflection in it.

question: Which material do we get from tall trees? 🌳
explanation: Super! Trees give us wonderful wood to make desks, chairs, and pencils! 🪵
hint: It comes from the trunk of a tree.

question: What is the seat of a bicycle often made of? 🚲
explanation: Wonderful! Soft foam makes the bicycle seat very comfy for long rides! 🚲
hint: It makes sitting comfortable.

question: Which of these feels cold and hard? 🧊
explanation: Awesome! An ice cube is frozen water, so it feels freezing cold and solid! 🧊
hint: It is frozen water.

question: What material is a shopping bag usually made from today? 🛍️
explanation: Great job! Shopping bags are made of cloth or plastic so they are light and easy to carry! 🛍️
hint: It is light and has handles.

question: Which of these will blow away in the wind? 🍃
explanation: Super! A dry leaf is so light that even a gentle breeze can blow it far away! 🍃
hint: It is very light and falls from trees.

question: What is a beautiful silk saree made of? 🥻
explanation: Fantastic! Silk threads are woven together to make a smooth and shiny saree! 🥻
hint: It comes from a tiny silkworm.
